summary: Count to 20, count up to 20 things one by one, see up to 5 at a glance, and match numerals to groups up to 10.
Compare things with words like taller and heavier, guess amounts, and measure length by lining up cubes.
Sort and group objects by two or more features, like size and color, and tell daily routines in order.
Say what comes next in a simple repeating pattern, and copy patterns made with objects or claps.
Name circles, squares, rectangles and triangles of any size or turn, and start to use words like behind and forward.
